paragraphs: Mar Zutra, son of Rav Mari: Nedarim 4a. He said to Ravina: Pesachim 62a; Kiddushin 7a, 21a; Bava Kamma 29b; Bava Metzia 55a, 66b. As for Rav Acha bar Rav, see there for the identification of this Ravina as the earlier one.
